messages:
Ravi P: FYI nightly invoicer produced duplicate invoices and missing proration merges for a subset of accounts. Noticed duplicate invoice_id on export and missing combined support proration.
Maya C: any batch id? sample invoice?
Ravi P: batch nb-20260410-04. sample: "invoice_id":"inv-20260410-11223" appears twice in export for acct 11223; lines show support split into two full-month charges instead of merged prorated amount.
billing-bot: Invoice batch nb-20260410-04 completed with warnings=INVOICE_ID_DUPLICATE,PRORATION_MERGE_FAIL count_warn=42
Tom H: sounds like a race between the rename-migration and the proration merge. We ran a short migration window yesterday.
Maya C: logs snippet: 2026-04-10T03:00:01Z migration INFO rename support->premium-support acct=11223
2026-04-10T03:00:02Z invoice-worker WARN merge: key collision L202 acct=11223
2026-04-10T03:00:02Z invoice-worker ERROR idgen: seq reset detected
Tom H: immediate actions: 1) stop nightly cron 2) pause migration 3) snapshot S3 exports 4) run idgen fix in staging then dry-run. I've stopped the cron.
Ravi P: creating ticket BILL-4357 to track. Finance estimates impacted AR ~ $14k.
Maya C: PR opened to make lineitem merge idempotent and harden idgen: https://github.com/redwood/billing-service/pull/3950. Adding unit test for concurrent migration.
Tom H: recommend targeted reissue for 42 affected invoices after validation; for already-paid invoices generate credit memos then reissue revised invoice.
Ravi P: agreed. CS notified. Will update this thread after dry-run at 09:00 UTC.
